subject: Global deployment playbook: EU/US/APAC architecture deep-dive
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Karlsson <simon.karlsson@nordicbank.se>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Global deployment playbook: EU/US/APAC architecture deep-dive

Hi Simon —

Thanks again for yesterday’s discovery call. Per our notes, NordicBank wants a focused technical session to walk through a multi-region architecture (EU primary, failover to US, APAC read-only replicas), data residency controls, and the runbook for cutover/failback.

Would you and the platform team be available for a 90-minute deep-dive this week? Our engineers (Karthik and Marissa) will present the proposed network/topology, KMS patterns, and rollout playbook. Suggested slots (CEST):
- Thu 24 Sep, 13:00–14:30 CEST
- Fri 25 Sep, 09:00–10:30 CEST

If neither works, send two windows that fit your core platform folks and we’ll adapt. I’ve attached the latest architecture diagram (arch-diagram-v2.pdf) and added a draft agenda in the Drive link.

Best,
Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: arch-diagram-v2.pdf
From: Simon Karlsson <simon.karlsson@nordicbank.se>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 17:05:12 +0200
Subject: Re: Global deployment playbook: EU/US/APAC architecture deep-dive

Hi Priyom —

Thanks, that sounds good. We can do Thu 24 Sep but only 13:30–15:00 CEST (we have a heavy ops window at 12:00–13:15). Also want to invite Anders (our security lead) — I’m cc’ing platform@nordicbank.se.

Couple of asks before the call:
- Can you include a short section on audit logging retention and cross-region log mirroring?
- Any notes on minimum RTO under the proposed topology?

If you update the agenda I’ll route to Anders and confirm.

Cheers,
Simon
Head of Platform
NordicBank
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Karlsson <simon.karlsson@nordicbank.se>
Cc: platform@nordicbank.se, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Global deployment playbook: EU/US/APAC architecture deep-dive

Simon —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the security ask. We’ll add a 15-minute audit/logging block and a RTO analysis. Karthik — can you include the RTO table and a short example failover timeline (RTO/RPO numbers) in slide 3? Marissa — please prep the network diagram showing cross-region peering and KMS key policy variants (EU-only keys vs. replicated keys).

Simon, I’ll update the agenda and send a calendar invite for Thu 24 Sep 13:30–15:00 CEST with the Drive link and the diagram attached. If Anders needs pre-reading, we can also drop a short SOC2/controls FAQ (it’s a 1–page PDF).

Thanks,
Priyom

Cc: platform@nordicbank.se, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 01:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Global deployment playbook: EU/US/APAC architecture deep-dive

Simon —

Quick update: Anders is available but only in the late-afternoon CEST window tomorrow. He just proposed Fri 25 Sep 15:00–16:30 CEST. I’m seeing a conflict for Marissa (personal commitment) so Karthik can lead the walkthrough if we move. Two options:

1) Keep Thu 24 Sep 13:30–15:00 CEST as proposed; Anders can forward any security questions and we’ll follow up in a shorter 30-minute security-only cadence next week.
2) Reschedule to Fri 25 Sep 15:00–16:30 CEST so Anders can attend live; Karthik leads Marissa’s sections and we record.

Please let me know which you prefer — if you pick option 2 I’ll send a revised invite and attach the SOC2/controls FAQ.

Thanks,
Priyom

Attachments: cal-invite-global-deploy.ics, arch-diagram-v2.pdf
From: Simon Karlsson <simon.karlsson@nordicbank.se>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: platform@nordicbank.se
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 11:14:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Global deployment playbook: EU/US/APAC architecture deep-dive

Priyom —

Let’s move to option 2 so Anders can be present. Fri 25 Sep 15:00–16:30 CEST works for the platform team. Please send the updated invite and the short SOC2 FAQ ahead of the session so Anders can skim.

We’ll expect the RTO table and the failover timeline in the deck; if Karthik can highlight the KMS variants during the meeting that would be ideal.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Simon
Head of Platform
NordicBank
